text:
Cheerful hello welfare crew,
The ramp coordinator sent an update on lounge layout

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk in the loop on any pet movement that affects the holding area, the boarding path, or the handoff at the gate. We rely on clean notes and calm handoffs so travelers feel supported and the animals stay settled. If a passenger arrives with a crate, carrier, or soft-sided bag, check the labels, confirm the documents are ready, and let us know right away if anything looks off. <<FACT F053>> When you send a note, keep it plain and specific, and include whether the animal is resting well, showing stress, or needs a quieter spot.

For lounge use, guide travelers toward the calmest seating area and remind them to keep doors clear for staff moving equipment. If Amara Costa or Diego Kowalski appear on your list, treat the interaction the same way you would any other companion animal case: steady voice, simple steps, and no extra fuss. If Trixie is mentioned, make sure the carrier remains secure and that water, bedding, and paperwork are easy to reach. The more predictable the route, the easier it is for crews to keep the cabin flow smooth and the animal comfortable.

If there is a delay in boarding or a change in the lounge setup, tell the companion animal desk at once so we can adjust guidance for the passenger before the next handoff. Please avoid crowding the animal, avoid sudden movements, and keep chatter low around any nervous traveler. We appreciate quick updates from the ramp, the gate, and the lounge because those small notes help Aurelia Skyways keep every companion animal trip steady and professional. Thanks for keeping the line of communication open and the workflow calm.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
